sloka: एषा त्रिपथगा गङ्गा दृश्यते वरवर्णिनि ।नानाद्विजगणाकीर्णा सम्प्रयुष्पितकानना ।। ६.१२६.४९ ।।
transliteration: eṣā tripathagā gaṅgā dṛśyate varavarṇini ।nānādvijagaṇākīrṇā samprayuṣpitakānanā ।। 6.126.49 ।।

translations.english: "Here is an auspicious, beautiful Godavari with pure water. Here is also seen the hermitage of Agastya surrounded by banana plants."
